records.jp: 前々から気になってはいたんだが、<CR>その本、ユキのか？
records.en_original: I've been meaning to ask... Are those books yours, Yuki?
records.en: I've been meaning to ask...<CR>Are those books yours, Yuki?

records.jp: うん、全部私の私物。<CR>メイも１冊読んでみる？　これとかおすすめ
records.en_original: Yep, they're all mine. Want to try reading one, Mei? Here, I recommend this one.
records.en: Yep, they're all mine.<CR>Want to try reading one, Mei? Here, I recommend this one.

records.jp: うーん……。タイトルも独特で面白そうだ。<CR>面白そうではあるが、如何せんこの量の活字は……
records.en_original: Hmm... The title's unique and it does look interesting. Still, that's an awful lot of text.
records.en: Hmm... The title's unique and it does look interesting.<CR>Still, that's an awful lot of text.

records.jp: そっか。そういう問題があるのか
records.en_original: Oh, so that's the issue.
records.en: Oh, so that's the issue.

records.jp: ああ。別に日本語が読めないわけではないんだが、<CR>さすがにこの分量だと疲れそうだと思ってな
records.en_original: Yeah. It's not like I can't read Japanese, but with this much to get through, I think I'd get tired.
records.en: Yeah. It's not like I can't read Japanese,<CR>but with this much to get through, I think I'd get tired.

records.jp: 確かに。<CR>私も英語の原書を読むのはかなり覚悟が必要だったっけ
records.en_original: True. It took a lot for me to work up the courage to read novels in English too, now that I think about it.
records.en: True. It took a lot for me to work up the courage to read<CR>novels in English too, now that I think about it.

records.jp: そうだ。それなら私が読み聞かせしてあげようか。<CR>……って、あれ、どうしたの？
records.en_original: I know, how about I read it to you instead? ...Wait, what's wrong?
records.en: I know, how about I read it to you instead?<CR>...Wait, what's wrong?

records.jp: いや、意外だったんだ。<CR>ユキがこんなに積極的に本を薦めてくるなんて
records.en_original: No, it's just surprising. I never thought you would be this eager to recommend books.
records.en: No, it's just surprising.<CR>I never thought you would be this eager to recommend books.

records.jp: 私もメイが本に興味を持っているとは思ってなくて。<CR>どうせならちょっと布教してみようかなって
records.en_original: I didn't think you would be interested in reading them. If that's the case, maybe I can convert you to my side.
records.en: I didn't think you would be interested in reading them.<CR>If that's the case, maybe I can convert you to my side.

records.jp: ほら、同好の士は貴重だから
records.en_original: See, fellow fans are rare, after all.
records.en: See, fellow fans are rare, after all.

records.jp: なるほど。それじゃあお願いしよう。<CR>ラジオドラマはよく聞くから楽しみだ
records.en_original: I see. All right, I'll take you up on that. I do listen to radio dramas, so I'm looking forward to it.
records.en: I see. All right, I'll take you up on that.<CR>I do listen to radio dramas, so I'm looking forward to it.

records.jp: へぇ。メイ、ラジオ聞くんだ
records.en_original: Really? You listen to the radio?
records.en: Really? You listen to the radio?

records.jp: や、やっぱり変だろうか。<CR>今どき、女子高生がラジオなんて……
records.en_original: I-is that weird? I mean, fair point, what kind of high school girl listens to the radio these days?
records.en: I-is that weird? I mean, fair point,<CR>what kind of high school girl listens to the radio these days?

records.jp: ゆ、ユキ……？　<CR>そんなに見つめられると、その……
records.en_original: Y-Yuki? If you stare at me like that—well, um...
records.en: Y-Yuki?<CR>If you stare at me like that—well, um...

records.jp: あ、ごめん。メイの恥じらい顔、初めて見た気がして。<CR>なんにせよ、別に変ではないと思うけど
records.en_original: Ah, sorry. It's just...I think that's the first time I've seen you blush, Mei. Anyway, I don't think it's weird at all.
records.en: Ah, sorry. It's just...I think that's the first time I've seen you blush, Mei.<CR>Anyway, I don't think it's weird at all.

records.jp: 趣味なんて人それぞれだと思うよ。<CR>まぁ、それこそ珍しくはあるけどね
records.en_original: Everyone has their own hobbies, after all. Well, I guess it's a little rare, though.
records.en: Everyone has their own hobbies, after all.<CR>Well, I guess it's a little rare, though.

records.jp: そ、そうか。<CR>そう言ってもらえると嬉しいな
records.en_original: I-is that so? I'm glad to hear you say that.
records.en: I-is that so?<CR>I'm glad to hear you say that.

records.jp: 私の読書趣味だって結構珍しい部類だし。<CR>そうだ。ラジオドラマの魅力、教えてくれない？
records.en_original: My love of reading is pretty unusual, too. Say, why don't you tell me what you love about radio dramas?
records.en: My love of reading is pretty unusual, too.<CR>Say, why don't you tell me what you love about radio dramas?

records.jp: え？　魅力？
records.en_original: Huh? What I love about them?
records.en: Huh? What I love about them?

records.jp: そうだな……。<CR>やはり余計な情報が無いのは魅力の一つだな
records.en_original: Let's see... I guess one thing is there's no unnecessary distractions. That's part of the charm.
records.en: Let's see... I guess one thing is there's no<CR>unnecessary distractions. That's part of the charm.

records.jp: 聴覚情報だけだから、話に集中できるし、<CR>逆に聞き流すことだってできるんだ
records.en_original: Since it's only about what you hear, I can really focus on the story—or, if I want, just have it on in the background.
records.en: Since it's only about what you hear, I can really focus on the story—or,<CR>if I want, just have it on in the background.

records.jp: あとは……なにより臨場感だな
records.en_original: But, more than anything else, it's the atmosphere.
records.en: But, more than anything else, it's the atmosphere.

records.jp: 臨場感？
records.en_original: Atmosphere?
records.en: Atmosphere?

records.jp: ああ。テレビだと映像は画面越しに見るしかない。<CR>だから傍観者という意識が抜けないんだが……
records.en_original: Yeah. On TV, you can only see things through the screen, so you always feel like an observer...
records.en: Yeah. On TV, you can only see things through the screen,<CR>so you always feel like an observer...

records.jp: その点、ラジオドラマには視覚的な壁が無いから、<CR>目を瞑れば物語の世界に入り込んだ気分になれる
records.en_original: But with radio dramas, there's no visual barrier—if you close your eyes, it feels like you're actually inside the story.
records.en: But with radio dramas, there's no visual barrier—if you close your eyes,<CR>it feels like you're actually inside the story.

records.jp: 雨音とか虫の声とか、効果音の演出もあるし<CR>目を瞑ると、ドラマの情景が目の前に広がるんだ
records.en_original: Especially when there are sound effects like rain or chirping insects, if you close your eyes, it's like the whole scene unfolds right before you.
records.en: Especially when there are sound effects like rain or chirping insects,<CR>if you close your eyes, it's like the whole scene unfolds right before you.

records.jp: そういうところが、私は魅力だとおも……う
records.en_original: That's the part I find most magical...
records.en: That's the part I find most magical...

records.jp: すまない、つい語りすぎた……
records.en_original: Oops, sorry, I got a little carried away.
records.en: Oops, sorry, I got a little carried away.

records.jp: 気にしない気にしない。メイの思いは伝わったよ。<CR>臨場感はわかるなぁ。小説も似たようなところがあるし
records.en_original: Don't worry about it, really! I totally get what you mean, Mei. The atmosphere is something I love about novels, too.
records.en: Don't worry about it, really! I totally get what you mean, Mei.<CR>The atmosphere is something I love about novels, too.

records.jp: そうなのか？
records.en_original: Really?
records.en: Really?

records.jp: 情景描写がしっかりした作品は特に、ね。<CR>主人公の家の間取りが浮かんだりするし
records.en_original: Yeah, especially with books that are rich in details. You can picture the layout of the main character's house and everything.
records.en: Yeah, especially with books that are rich in details.<CR>You can picture the layout of the main character's house and everything.

records.jp: 不思議なものだな。<CR>見えないものが見えるような、そんな感覚だ
records.en_original: It's kind of a mysterious feeling—like you can see things that aren't actually there.
records.en: It's kind of a mysterious<CR>feeling—like you can see things that aren't actually there.

records.jp: ね。案外文字や音は視覚情報になり得る、なんてね。<CR>それにしても、私たち、やっぱり相性いいかも
records.en_original: Right? Words and sounds create visuals in our minds, in a way. Anyway, maybe we really are a good match.
records.en: Right? Words and sounds create visuals in our minds, in a way.<CR>Anyway, maybe we really are a good match.

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: お互いに似た趣味を持ってるってわかったわけだし。<CR>そういう共通点があるのって、バディっぽいなって
records.en_original: Now that we know we have similar hobbies, it feels right for us to be partners with these common interests.
records.en: Now that we know we have similar hobbies,<CR>it feels right for us to be partners with these common interests.

records.jp: ラジオ少女と文学少女のコンビ、なかなかいいでしょ
records.en_original: The radio girl and the bookworm, teaming up. Not bad, huh?
records.en: The radio girl and the bookworm, teaming up. Not bad, huh?

records.jp: そんなこと、考えたこともなかったな……。<CR>ラジオ少女と文学少女……。いい響きだ
records.en_original: I never thought about it like that before... The radio girl and the bookworm... It has a nice ring to it.
records.en: I never thought about it like that before...<CR>The radio girl and the bookworm... It has a nice ring to it.

records.jp: でしょ。<CR>あ。今度はメイのおすすめのラジオドラマ、教えてよ
records.en_original: Right? Oh! Next time, tell me about any radio dramas you'd recommend, Mei.
records.en: Right? Oh!<CR>Next time, tell me about any radio dramas you'd recommend, Mei.

records.jp: え？　おすすめ……私のおすすめか……。<CR>分かった、明日までに考えておこう
records.en_original: Huh? Recommendations? Okay, I'll think about it for tomorrow.
records.en: Huh? Recommendations?<CR>Okay, I'll think about it for tomorrow.

records.jp: やった。<CR>よし、それじゃあ読み聞かせをはじめよっか
records.en_original: Yay! All right, let's start story time, then!
records.en: Yay!<CR>All right, let's start story time, then!
